coding: ordered symptom substring rules then source-class fallback; no human or independent judge validation
grouping: record IDs are frozen placeholders only, not independent incidents; incident group and links unknown without evidence
query: select id,task_ref,harness,error_class,summary,tool_name,package_name,package_version,occurrence_count,created_at,last_seen_at from agent_errors order by last_seen_at desc,id desc limit 240
row_hash: SHA-256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(source row, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma,colon)); no newline
sampling: latest 240 records by last_seen_at desc, id desc; nonprobability bounded snapshot
source: handoff.db operational agent_errors; not application production traffic
summary_hash: SHA-256 of UTF-8 original summary; null encoded as empty bytes
